root_problem: standard-chain 受控试点前仍存在 target-change 消费契约漂移和 rg absence gate 假绿风险
business_goals: 让 Codex-only standard-chain 受控试点能发现并阻断 target-change stale-ref 漂移和 shell absence gate 假绿
acceptance_criteria: target-change 在 catalog、主链合同、field consumption matrix、validator 和 consistency-auditor 输入中一致声明并被 gate 消费
rg absence checks 能区分未命中与搜索错误，相关 standard-chain shell gates 不再把 rg exit 2 当作通过
design_decisions: 用现有 standard-chain validators 锁 target-change default path 和 consistency-auditor gate consumer
新增 assert_rg_no_match helper 并替换目标内 absence callers，fail closed 处理 rg 搜索错误
scope_boundaries: 只覆盖当前 standard-chain controlled pilot readiness 的目标内 P0/P1 修复，不启动全运行时推广

delivery_plan.goal: 用一个真实低风险需求跑完 Codex-only standard-chain controlled pilot 到 signoff-package 和 user-decision

user_profile.workaround_cost: 容易把 fixture-only 误报为团队可投入使用证据

feasibility_constraints.constraint: actual pilot must be current canonical artifacts, not copied fixture evidence
feasibility_constraints.handling: register active scope, produce worklog, and rerun context/readiness validators

risks_and_unknowns.item: full gate remains intentionally unrun per user constraint
risks_and_unknowns.impact: evidence proves controlled pilot and quick/targeted gates, not full CI parity
risks_and_unknowns.mitigation: report full gate as intentionally excluded and keep no full-gate completion claim

decision_rationale.decision: use the target-change/rg absence hardening as actual pilot demand
decision_rationale.choice: low-risk repository-local contract and shell gate fix with fresh validators
decision_rationale.rationale: it exercises product, design, test, implementation, verification, QA, review, consistency audit, and delivery-owner closeout without requiring external systems
decision_rationale.excluded_options: fixture-only replay or broad all-runtime rollout
